action.message: I'm helping my mom review her Medicare. She's happy with her doctors but wants to understand whether her coverage still makes sense.

turns.reply: We can review the coverage in place first, without assuming a change is needed. A useful review looks at doctor participation, prescription coverage, and both monthly payments and costs when getting care—not just the premium. Identifying the current coverage is the best starting point.
turns.question: What health insurance does your mom have now? If you’re unsure of the type, you can share the plan names printed on her coverage cards, without any member numbers.

turns.notice: Daylight could not verify a name in the AI reply. Your reported details are kept.
turns.question: What ZIP code do you live in?
